limits: Area-input sensitivity is a model diagnostic, not a forecast for physically expanded cells, not a causal effect, and not an area-normalized probability.
Holding other predictors fixed can create implausible combinations because terrain, climate, location and clipped geometry are associated. Marginal area support does not establish joint support.

Do not score altered-area probabilities against original-area outcomes or interpret membership changes as accuracy gains. Do not divide probabilities or binary positive-cell counts by area to infer fire intensity.
Area SHAP values describe the stored model and share attribution with correlated predictors; subtracting an area SHAP value is not a fitted model without area.

The target is at least one recorded WF discovery per county-clipped cell and year, not property loss, fire severity or intrinsic per-area hazard. Reporting completeness and historical as-issued climate availability remain unverified.
Area strata and within-year geographic summaries are descriptive; they do not remove all geographic confounding or spatial dependence. No significance tests or independent-cell uncertainty claims.
No changes to the frozen ML v1 model, baseline, existing labels, prior outputs, or final-test protocol. No 2022-2025 targets, features or predictions parsed or evaluated.
